raw_segments.text: offering his arm to Ayyutta, he directed his steps toward the docks in search of some craft
about to start. Fix, stupefied, followed. It seemed as if he were attached to Mr. Fog
by an invisible thread. Chance, however, appeared really to have abandoned the man it had hitherto
served so well. For three hours Philia's Fog wandered about the docks, with the determination,
if necessary, to charter a vessel to carry him to Yokohama. But he could only find vessels
which were loading or unloading, and which could not therefore set sail. Fix began to hope again.
